verdict.rationale: Okta's official open-source MCP server lets LLMs and AI agents perform Okta management operations in natural language. Example prompts cover creating users, querying failed logins and listing unused apps. Natural-language operation depends on an external LLM or agent client rather than being built into the Okta product itself, and no hands-on reports confirm how well it works. Missing for 10: native natural-language interface in the Okta admin console, documented breadth of supported operations, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: The Okta Open Source MCP Server integrates with LLMs and AI agents, allowing you to perform various Okta management operations using natural language.
This server is an Model Context Protocol server that provides seamless integration with Okta's Admin Management APIs.
